scope: Independent retained complete assembly/pseudocode and exact new production-source review for four normal pool-destructor byte-state projections and four existing-provider source bindings. No original-file reads, original execution or reviewer tests.
base_table_evidence_kind: Retained LEA immediate identity; no new base-table bytes or runtime pointer observation
findings: Each wrapper selects the exact observed type-table immediate:001bb0->07fe38,001c30->07fe98,001cb0->07fe68,001d30->07fe08.

Raw DWORD count+64 is tested before the initial QWORD type-table publication; the cached entry flag controls if/do-while entry, preserving original CMP flags when aliased backing lets the vtable store change live count.
An entered loop immediately rereads signed old count, stores wrapping DWORD old-1, then loads live array data+8 and block slot using cached signed64 old_index*8-8 with modulo64 address arithmetic.
Lower pointer-only free is followed by live raw count nonzero test; negative values and callback changes to count,data,slots or vptr are not sanitized or rolled back.
Three ordered QWORD zero stores reset+68,+70,+78 before any array-pointer lookup, retaining access width and completed prefixes.
Array data is loaded live after loop/resets and freed only when unequal to pool+10, forwarding null or mutated noninline pointers without invented guard.
The final QWORD base-table identity07fa18 store occurs after optional array-free returns; no resetting data pointer,capacity,count,inline bytes or stale entries and no object deallocation is added.
Block EDX4080/4056/4032/4080 observations remain static facts; array-free callsites define only RCX. Existing pointer-only free interface is retained without sized-free/register ABI claims.
RecoveredPoolDestructEffects retains inherited document/node/pool-clear bindings and closes exactly four existing NativeDocumentEffects destructor providers on shared bounded memory.

One tagged normal body plus one tagged final bridge per target gives two definition variants; four wrappers and four bridges do not imply eight native functions. Immediate table values are never dereferenced or called.
limitations: Bounded byte-state normal source projection only; native register/fault/object ABI, unwind/EH and concurrency equivalence remain unproven.
Free04b0f8 remains a mandatory lower effect; heap/CRT bodies, allocation provenance and native lifetime correctness are not established.
Node virtual/base destruction, parser/DOM materialization and full document/pool lifecycle or whole-DLL equivalence remain open.
Bounded mapping exceptions and fixture effects are source-interface behavior, not native fault or execution proof.
